tcs.tc_title: AUX cameras are accessible from the Apps Drawer
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. A wired AUX camera is connected
3. The shift lever is in P
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Apps" on Menu Bar to open App Drawer
2. Select the AUX camera soft control in the App Drawer
3. Read the HU display and check that the AUX 1 camera view is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The App Drawer is displayed
2. The AUX camera soft control registers the selection
3. The AUX 1 camera view is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: AUX cameras are accessible from the Apps Drawer
tcs.test_item:
Apps Drawer

(AUX cameras are accessible from the Apps Drawer)

reasoning: §27.2.6.2 為 `Accessible from` 節（§27.2.6）下之入口列舉之一，Description 逐字即 `Apps Drawer`（2 token）。同節之 §27.2.6.3（`Camera app home page`）由 `-058` 承接。App Drawer 之進入句式沿 A 本 `NR1L-RVC-113`（**R-CAM1(b)**），故不掛 DR-CAM-g。H 本 §27.7.1 逐字 `All Wired and Wireless Aux cameras will be accessible via the controls page and apps drawer` 為同一入口之第二處記載（該列為 B02b 之 `SWE1-RVC-084`）。
